answer: Each agent identity is admitted only after a TPM/SGX enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation binding code, key, and device nonce to the cedar state tree; the pigment consensus contract verifies the proof and commits its digest to an anchor hash. Forging N identities requires compromising or physically duplicating N attested devices and paying a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), with failed proofs causing irreversible collateral slashing.
